candidate_metrics_not_enforced_by_curren.required_handling: measure and report in N10.3; create a real shared acceptance evaluator in N10.4 before treating any as a formal pass gate

hypothesis.basis: #347 used the same 0.25 m/s/axis, 0.25 m/s^2/axis, 1.0 m horizon planner candidate and was stopped by the extra 0.12 m/s reference guard before reaching the 16 m goal. #348 removed both extra project-specific speed caps, retained EGO planner dynamics and other navigation contracts, and built/regression-tested the resulting source without flight.
hypothesis.criterion: Complete the single +16.0 m ENU / +0.10 m / +0.20 rad goal and 3 simulation-second dwell; independently confirm truth position <=0.30 m and yaw <=15 deg continuously for >=3 simulation seconds; then maintain bridge ACTIVE for 600 simulation seconds while required localization/PX4 freshness remains valid and the clock advances. Record, but do not gate or cancel on, EGO reference and measured PX4 speed. Require no prohibited/unobserved contact and final landed/disarmed with bridge control disabled.
hypothesis.one_primary_variable: Compared with #347, remove the user-rejected additional numerical speed guard policy: no 0.12 m/s EGO-reference/PX4-measured speed cancellation, and no 0.10 m/s total / 0.01 m/s vertical cancel-stop admission rejection.
hypothesis.termination: Existing localization, map, identity, PX4 freshness, bridge state-machine, mission-timeout, wall-watchdog, contact and simulation-clock behavior remains unchanged. A failure is handled by the existing bridge-owned landing path where available and reported as a failed/incomplete sample. Speed magnitude alone is not a termination condition.

scope: First post-#348 single-D435i official_ego PX4 SITL calibration: the original 16 m 3D/yaw single goal, independent arrival/dwell, 600 simulated-second ACTIVE observation, then bridge-owned landing. Speed is observation-only.
